bell.label: Notifications
panel.title: Needs attention
panel.intro: What waits for someone with your role in this workspace. Items clear by themselves once they are dealt with.
panel.empty: Nothing needs your attention right now.
panel.error: Notifications could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
kind.approvals_waiting.title: {count, plural, one {# item waits for a decision} other {# items wait for a decision}}
kind.approvals_waiting.body: In {course}: answers to grade, second opinions, checkpoint reviews, media or versions waiting for approval. The overview lists them.
kind.ai_check_needed.title: {role} needs a quality check
kind.ai_check_needed.body: Its setup changed, for example in an upgrade, and has not passed a check yet. It keeps working meanwhile. Run the check on the AI services page.
kind.ai_check_needed.bodyFailed: Its last quality check failed. It keeps working meanwhile. Open the AI services page to see why and run the check again.
kind.ai_check_needed.bodyUncheckable: This setup cannot be checked automatically. It keeps working meanwhile. An owner can approve it on the AI services page.
kind.jobs_failed.title: {count, plural, one {# AI run failed in the last day} other {# AI runs failed in the last day}}
kind.jobs_failed.body: In {course}. The run inspector shows what went wrong and lets you retry.
kind.budget_near_limit.title: AI spending is at {percent}% of the limit
kind.budget_near_limit.body: When the limit is reached, AI work that costs money waits until the limit is raised. Change the limit on the AI services page.
kind.help_paused.workspace.title: AI help is paused: the AI budget is used up
kind.help_paused.workspace.body: In the last day {requests, plural, one {# request for AI help} other {# requests for AI help}} from {learners, plural, one {# learner} other {# learners}} waited. Learners are told that help is paused and that staff know. Raise the workspace limit on the AI services page; learners can then ask again.
kind.help_paused.learner.title: {learners, plural, one {# learner reached their own AI limit} other {# learners reached their own AI limit}}
kind.help_paused.learner.body: In the last day {requests, plural, one {# request for AI help} other {# requests for AI help}} waited. These learners are told that help is paused and that staff know. Raise the limit per learner on the AI services page, or the daily and per-lesson limits in AI supervision settings; they can then ask again.
kind.backups_overdue.title: Backups are overdue
kind.backups_overdue.body: The newest backup is {minutes} minutes old; the target is at most {target} minutes. Check the backup job on the Platform page.
kind.unknown.title: Something needs attention
